template_data.lead_html: No past performance doesn't mean no shot. It means wrong partner.

rows.what_html: Find the right prime — capability gap + customer access, not just a name on paper
Define workshare in writing — scope, percentage, and who owns the client relationship post-award
Build a path to prime — teaming is a ladder, not a permanent floor

template_data.closer: PAST PERFORMANCE IS BORROWED. USE IT.
